Description

Looking to hire a 5-a-side football pitch in South London? Battersea Sports Centre has the perfect facilities for lovers of the small-sided version of the beautiful game. 5-a-side football at Battersea Sports Centre is played on 3G astroturf. So whether you're looking for a casual kick about with your friends or whether you're part of a team that is a cohesive 5-a-side football machine, Battersea Sports Centre is the right choice for you.

This facility has floodlights. These powerful spotlights remove the concern about it being too dark and mean that you can play all year round.

If you’re travelling by car, then you’ll be glad to know there is free parking provided by the venue. The free parking at the facility can fill up at peak times and get busy, with weekends being a very popular time, so allow ample time to ensure you secure a space.

Customers will be pleased to know that the venue operates a pay-as-you-play booking system. This means sports enthusiasts can just turn up and play depending on availability and book on a pay as you play basis. This method avoids the monthly membership charges and gives you the freedom to play as and when you like, without the commitment of a weekly game or a membership fee.

Looking to set up regular games at Battersea Sports Centre? Enquire about making a block booking to ensure you secure the time slot you want to play at every week. Block bookings are perfect for teams who want to be assured that they'll be playing regularly. A block booking is a booking made for a set number of consecutive weeks, on average this is 10 weeks. The venue has changing facilities to use when you book, they are well maintained and suitable for teams or individuals. It's also great for teams as it means you can prepare for games in comfort and in good time.

The venue is situated near Clapham Junction station. From there it is a short walk to the facility which works out well for a gentle warm down after your booking.
